query: I finally managed to finish that 1000-piece landscape jigsaw puzzle I’ve been working on for three weeks last night, the mountain sunset section was so tricky I almost gave up three separate times. I also picked up a new matcha scone from the bakery down the street this morning, it had just the right amount of sweetness and a really flaky crust that didn’t crumble everywhere when I bit into it. My cat even knocked over my potted succulent earlier, luckily the plant was totally fine and I only had to sweep up a little bit of dirt off the floor. Anyway, my mobile service isn’t working right now, I have airplane mode turned on, I got a notification that my line is suspended because I have an overdue bill, and I think my SIM card might be unseated too, can you help me figure out what I need to do to fix this?
